"Tribal Dance" is a song by Belgian/Dutch Eurodance band 2 Unlimited.
It was released in April 1993 as the second single from the band's second album, No Limits!
The UK release omits the main rap but leaves in more vocals from band member Ray Slijngaard than any of their previous releases.
